title: 第25章 躲在床底下瑟瑟发抖的云微第26章 咬破了耳朵
slug: 聚灵飞升第1126章暗流之下
content_zh:
云昊心急如焚。
他脑海中想了很多。
如今世道不太平。
他们清水村隶属大虞王朝边陲之地，听说边界一直在打仗，虽然战乱还没有波及到小山村，但流民匪患却在周边有不少。
昨天去镇上的时候，他还听到过说是星河镇几十里外一些村落遭了匪患。
听到的时候，云昊不以为然，当时也没有多想。
这会儿看到村里冒起的浓烟，他不自觉的就想到是不是土匪进村了？
边陲之地，尤其是小山村压根就没有什么官差来管。
世道乱，有土匪也不奇怪。
云昊骑在老马背上，心里一直在跳。
别人他管不着，担心的是姐姐云微。
土匪可没有什么道义可言。
此刻的清水村，撕裂的哭喊声起伏不断。
到处浓烟滚滚。
的确是土匪进村了。
正在烧杀掠虐。
一伙三十多人的土匪。
抢粮食，杀人，更抢人。
抢的是女人。
更甚者，直接当场杀了阻碍的男人，将女人按在了地上，行不法之事。

这伙土匪，正是来自百里外黑风山的土匪。
说起来，还是流云武馆柴锦玉派去张磊专门送信招来的。
领头的土匪是黑风山三当家——飞毛腿陈虎。
昨天手下一名心腹，说是星河镇流云武馆来人，告知清水村几十户人家有富户，其中还有个叫云昊的小子，在镇上卖过人参药材等等，得了不少银子。
而清水村人口少，也远离官府，是个不错选择。
他们黑风山发展起来后，有几百号人要养活，大旱之年缺少粮食，黑风山四周能抢的都被抢光了。
只能向更远地方扩张。
三位当家，本就有意向星河镇伸出毒手。
恰好收到这个消息，大当家就让陈虎带着三十几号人来了清水村。
压根就没有碰到反抗。
开始了烧杀掠夺。
陈虎的重点在云昊家。
杀了几个人后，自然就知道了云昊家的位置。
骑着马来到了云家大门外。
身为黑风山三当家，他自然是有大马骑乘的。
还有几名小头目，数十个骑马的土匪。
星河镇流云武馆的人可是说了，要让重点照顾一个叫云昊的小子。
陈虎虽然猜到是流云武馆想借刀杀人，但无所谓。
对他来说，只要此行有收获就成。
“三当家就是这家。”
content_en:
Yunhao was extremely anxious.
He had a lot going on in his mind.
The world is not peaceful now.
Qingshui Village belongs to the border area of ​​Dayu Dynasty. I heard that there has been a war on the border. Although the war has not affected the small mountain village, there are many refugees and bandits in the surrounding area.
When he went to town yesterday, he also heard that some villages dozens of miles away from Xinghe Town were suffering from banditry.
When he heard it, Yun Hao didn't take it seriously and didn't think much about it at the time.
When he saw the thick smoke rising from the village, he unconsciously wondered if bandits had entered the village?
Border areas, especially small mountain villages, have no official duties at all.
The world is in chaos, so it’s not surprising that there are bandits.
Yunhao was riding on the old horse, his heart beating all the time.
He couldn't care about others, he was worried about his sister Yun Wei.
There is nothing moral about bandits.
At this moment, Qingshui Village was filled with tearful cries.
There was thick smoke billowing everywhere.
It is true that bandits have entered the village.
They are burning, killing and looting.
A group of more than thirty bandits.
They robbed food, killed people, and even robbed people.
It was women who were being robbed.
What's more, he killed the man who blocked him on the spot, pushed the woman to the ground, and committed illegal acts.
This group of bandits were bandits from Black Wind Mountain a hundred miles away.
Speaking of which, Chai Jinyu of Liuyun Martial Arts School sent Zhang Lei to specifically deliver a letter to recruit him.
The leading bandit is Scud Chen Hu, the third master of Black Wind Mountain.
Yesterday, one of his confidants, who was said to be from the Xinghe Town Liuyun Martial Arts Hall, informed that dozens of households in Qingshui Village had wealthy families, including a boy named Yun Hao, who had sold ginseng and medicinal materials in the town and earned a lot of money.
Qingshui Village has a small population and is far away from the government, so it is a good choice.
After they developed Black Wind Mountain, they had hundreds of people to feed. In years of severe drought, they lacked food, and everything around Black Wind Mountain was robbed.
It can only expand further.
The three heads had originally intended to extend their poisonous hand to Xinghe Town.
Just after receiving this news, the headmaster asked Chen Hu to bring more than thirty people to Qingshui Village.
There was no resistance at all.
The burning, killing and looting began.
Chen Hu's focus is on Yunhao's family.
After killing a few people, he naturally knew the location of Yunhao's family.
Riding a horse, he arrived outside the Yun family gate.
As the third master of Black Wind Mountain, he naturally has a big horse to ride on.
There are also several small bosses and dozens of bandits on horseback.
The people from Xinghe Zhenliu Yun Martial Arts Hall said that they should focus on taking care of a boy named Yun Hao.
Although Chen Hu guessed that Liuyun Martial Arts wanted to borrow a knife to kill people, it didn't matter.
For him, as long as the trip is fruitful, that's all.
"This is the Third Master's family."
